# Apiverve

APIVerve offers a comprehensive suite of APIs designed to simplify integration processes, providing developers with scalable and reliable solutions for various applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/apiverve/.

## Actions

- **Air Quality** (read-only): Get air quality data for a city.
- **Currency Converter** (read-only): Convert currency rates.
- **Get Word Definition** (read-only): Get the definition of a word.
- **Advice Generator** (read-only): Generate a random piece of advice.
- **Age Calculator** (read-only): Calculate age from date of birth.
- **App Store Scraper** (read-only): Fetch detailed app metadata from the app store.
- **Find antonyms for a word** (read-only): Get antonyms for a word.
- **Get Airline Info by Name** (read-only): Get airline info by name.
- **Get airport distance by IATA** (read-only): Get distance between two airports by their iata codes.
- **Get Airport Info by ICAO Code** (read-only): Get airport information by icao code.
- **Weather by City** (read-only): Get current weather by city.
